S01/run_0_crash.summary: Rear-end: A critical on B 2.35 s before the contact (B braking ahead); END with the COLLISION; bodies in contact at the collision.

findings.problem: none: CRITICAL_TTC from -2.35 to the collision, positions and headings plausible

S02/run_0_crash.summary: B cuts in from the left ahead of A: CRITICAL_TTC, CUT_IN_FROM_LEFT and EGO_PATH_ENTRY in that order, collision of A's front with B's rear.

S02/run_0_critical_before_cut_in.summary: CRITICAL_TTC (-1.50) before CUT_IN_FROM_LEFT (-1.15) before EGO_PATH_ENTRY (-0.45); B rotated by the impact afterwards.

findings.problem: none (the automatic box-jump flag on B:track_001 concerned an associated track, drawn as a dot; the check is now restricted to ghosts)

S03/run_0_crash.summary: Crossing: both recorders critical about 1.5 s before; B strikes the side of A; both episodes end with the collision.

S06/run_0_a_front_pushed.summary: Chain A->B->C: A-B at 0.00 ends the episode of A, B pushed into C at +0.50 ends the episode of B on C; second A-B contact at +0.65.

findings.problem: none (the automatic 'END before own collision' flag was the END of A at the first A-B contact, 0.65 s before the second one; check fixed)

S06/run_0_b_rear_first.summary: B into C at -1.55 (END B->C), A critical on the stopped chain from -1.55, A into B at 0.00 (END A->B).

S07/run_0_crash.summary: Occluded chain stop consistent (A critical on B, A into B); the recorder C also appears as the anonymous ghost B:track_001 (no B-C collision to associate it); shown on the source clock because C has no collision to be aligned.

findings.problem: ghost B:track_001 drawn on the recorder C (second body for C)
findings.solution: PHASE 1: associate anonymous tracks with recorders in a common frame

findings.problem: replay on source time: recorder C is not collision-aligned
findings.solution: PHASE 2: documented; aligning a collision-free recorder is outside collision anchoring

S08/run_0_crash.summary: Multi-direction crossing A-B consistent; recorder C seen as two ghosts (A:track_001, B:track_001) and the tracks of A and B by C anonymous; post-impact ghost heading of B:track_001 rotated about 45 deg while B spins.

findings.problem: two ghosts of the recorder C (A:track_001, B:track_001)
box heading of B:track_001 off by about 45 deg after the impact of B (observer spinning)

S09/run_0_merge_conflict.summary: FAIL found and fixed: the CRITICAL_TTC of A on B ended 0.80 s before the collision while B, merging along a curve, was 2-3 m away and closing at 1.6-3.5 m/s (line-of-sight time to contact 0.66-0.83 s); the release now waits until no line-of-sight contact is imminent; both episodes end at the collision.

findings.problem: premature CRITICAL_TTC_END(A, B): the straight-line target prediction misses the curved merge of B while the radar shows B closing with a 0.66-0.83 s time to contact
findings.solution: release condition: no imminent line-of-sight contact (closing >= 1 m/s and clearance < 1 s x closing speed); END now at the collision

S10/run_0_rolls_through.summary: Junction collision consistent; the track of A by B stays anonymous (ghost box offset about 1.5 m on A) and its box jumps and spins right after the impact.

findings.problem: B:track_001 (A) anonymous: a second body on A
ghost box jump and spin at the impact

S12/run_0_near_simultaneous.summary: All-way stop: both critical about 1.2 s before, B enters the path of A, collision, rotation after.

S15/run_0_deflected_into_c.summary: B into A at 0.00, A deflected into C at +0.90, each episode ends at the collision of its own pair; B:track_001 switches from C to A at the A-C contact (ground truth); several anonymous ghosts of recorders.

findings.problem: B:track_001 follows C, then A after A is pushed into C (track identity switch); its episode from +0.15 concerns C, not a post-impact episode with A
anonymous ghosts of recorders (C:track_002 = B, B:track_001)

S16/run_0_consequential.summary: B into A at 0.00, A into the van C at +1.05; episodes end at their collisions; the van C (a recorder) appears as several anonymous ghosts; the episode of C on A stays open when C loses the track of A 0.15 s before their contact.

findings.problem: van C drawn with up to 3 extra ghosts (A:track_002, B:track_002/003/004)
CRITICAL_TTC(C, A) open at TRACK_LOST 0.15 s before the A-C contact
findings.solution: track lost before the contact: no partner can be attributed; reported

S17/run_0_crash.summary: Consistent semantics: A critical on the cutting-in C from -2.35, CUT_IN -2.20, path entry -1.60; A-B and B-A end at the collision, A on C at +0.55; C (records nothing) is drawn as three ghosts.

findings.problem: C seen as A:track_001, B:track_002 and B:track_003 (three ghosts about 1.5-2 m apart)
